actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free‑riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is below 30% of initial, so contribution is reduced to 30% of wallet (~1.76). Round 6 requires the periodic norm broadcast.

message.reasoning: We need decide action. Wallet 5.85, baseline 80% would be 4.68 but rule: if wallet <30% of initial (30) then reduce contribution to 30% of wallet = 1.755. So can contribute 1.76 approx. Should follow constitution: contribute at least 80% unless low wallet rule triggers. Wallet 5.85 <30 so reduced to 30% = 1.755. So we can contribute that amount. Also need broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1. Round 6, last broadcast was round1, next at round6? first round = round1, then every 5 => round6 broadcast. So should broadcast norm. We can also punish? No free-rider detection: Resident1 contributed 1 each round5 and6, that's 1% of endowment (<10) for two consecutive rounds, triggers punish with amount 10 costing 3. Our wallet 5.85 can afford. Punish rule says punish agents who contributed less than 10% for two consecutive rounds. Resident1 qualifies. So we can punish. But can only one physical action. Choose punish or contribute? Constitution: prioritize contribution? It says contribute generously each round. But also punish free-riders. Which higher? Probably both but limit one. Choose punish? Might lose contribution but wallet low. I think contribute small and also broadcast. No punish. Explanation.
